runtimeRequirement.notes: PowerShell 7.4 or newer and GitHub CLI are required for live observations.

derivedFrom.guidance: This is intentionally customized provider policy. Preserve the recorded upstream version and digest, document ignored identities, and bump evidence normalization when the activity set changes.

cursor.replay: The cursor covers PR identity, head SHA, state, ignored identities, and sorted external review/comment identities. Comment text edits do not create a new event.

semantics.terminal: Merged or closed PRs return eventless terminal, including preflight-declared terminal and a close between preflight and the first attempt.
semantics.duplicates: Event IDs are deterministic from PR number and normalized activity cursor. Recipients must deduplicate repeated event IDs.

initialEmission.actionable: Existing substantive external activity emits on the first attempt because it is a naturally actionable condition.
initialEmission.synthetic: This template has no synthetic snapshot or created event.

semantics.diagnostics: Identity, authentication, provider, and configuration failures return schema-valid degraded results and write a structured detectorDiagnostic JSON record to stderr only.

credentials.policy: Use the GitHub CLI credential store or allowlist GH_TOKEN. Keep ignored logins in parameters and credentials out of request JSON.

scheduling.maxSafeDowntimeRationale: Reviews and issue comments are normally durable, but the GitHub CLI response is not a promised unbounded history and deleted activity cannot be recovered.
